BIRSA AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY
KANKE, RANCHI-834006 (JHARKHAND)
No. F3. Rectt.301/2024-BAU(VC)/ 64(Ǔन.) Dated- 25.06.2026
NOTICE
Candidates who applied for the post of Assistant Professor cum Junior Scientist
(Contractual) advertised vide Advt. No. BAU(VC) 04/2026 (Backlog) & BAU(VC) 05/2026 dated
10.04.2026, their application forms have been screened by Screening Committee. The candidate
whose application is Not Qualified (N.Q) for the post is mentioned below with the reason thereof.
If candidates have any queries regarding reason of disqualification, they may contact via
recruitment mail i.e, recruitmentbau50@gmail.com within seven days of issue of this order.
After the due date, University will not consider any request of the candidates. The Scheduled
date, place & time of Interview will be intimated later on by E-mail/telephonically to the
Qualified Candidates. The list of Not Qualified (N.Q) candidates is mentioned as under :-
